visualCharacteristics: White background, interactive testimonial switcher. A row of tab buttons (each an avatar + name + role) switches the active panel, which shows a large person photo beside their name, role and a quote.
contentPattern: Each item provides a tab label (avatar, name, role) and a panel (photo, name, role, quote); one panel visible at a time.
usage: Testimonials or customer quotes presented as switchable tabbed panels.
